issues.description: Method private static func assembleBookstore is inconsistently declared: the Solution repository defines private static func assembleBookstore(count: Int) -> Bookstore (adds an Int parameter) while the Solution's main() calls assembleBookstore() with no arguments. The Template repository shows a commented expected signature private static func assembleBookstore() -> Bookstore (no parameters), and the Problem Statement describes implementing assembleBookstore that creates and returns a Bookstore (no parameter). This mismatch (parameter present in the solution but absent in the call, template, and problem) will cause a compile-time error and prevents students from running or testing the provided main().
issues.suggestedFix: Make the assembleBookstore function signature consistent across artifacts. Change the Solution implementation to: private static func assembleBookstore() -> Bookstore (no parameters) and adapt its internal call sites accordingly so main() can call assembleBookstore() without arguments. Alternatively, if a parameter is desired, update the Template and Problem Statement to declare the parameter and update the main() call to supply an argument or give the parameter a default value; however, to preserve the stated exercise intent, prefer removing the count parameter in the Solution.
